summary: All four SPEC items are implemented as specified. The remote delete is a single porcelain push with a per-branch --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<b>:<listed sha>. Each refused branch is reported on its own line from the '!' porcelain lines, with exit 1, and other failures keep the generic path. The helper renames are complete (the SPEC-04 grep prints nothing; the count is 2), and the locked TASK-1.24 tests and README are untouched. The tests would catch a broken implementation. Without the lease, origin's doit/a would be deleted and the branches assertion fails. If refusals went through the generic path, the stderr would mention doit/c and lack the 'refused to delete' text. The SPEC-02 checks compare byte-identical ref snapshots and the push marker. tests/git passes (10/10). There are no BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
